meta.derived_from: the 8 question texts and the 28 Deccan chunks in app/data/cat4_fixtures.py only; never from stored answers

categories.commercial: a commercial term of this supplier's contracts (amount, %, date, duration, named party, certificate/contract/registration number); supplier_specific = true
categories.statutory: statutory constant or section number identical for any supplier; supplier_specific = false
categories.mechanism: contractual mechanism worded identically in every supplier's documents (not transformed), so it cannot distinguish suppliers; supplier_specific = false
categories.structure: schedule / clause label identical across suppliers (document structure); supplier_specific = false

meta.matching: Category 3 normaliser + boundary guard (app/archetypes/cat3_assistants/scoring.py), plus a decimal guard: an alternative that starts with a digit must not follow '<digit>.' and one that ends with a digit must not be followed by '.<digit>' (so '25 crore' does not hit '33.25 crore')
meta.alternative_sources: any_of: strings found in the fact's own chunk (block text, section heading or keywords; tested). also_in_corpus: the same value as worded in another Deccan chunk (tested). format_variants: added by one dry pass over the 24 golden answers, solely as other spellings of the same value (listed in meta.format_variants_added).
meta.question_values_excluded: no alternative occurs in its own question text (tested), so restating the question earns nothing

format_variants_added.observed: golden naive audit-01/q1 writes 'INR 15.00 Cr' / 'INR 15 Cr'
golden naive and cached audit-01/q3 write 'INR 85.00 Cr'

meta.format_variant_pass: One dry pass over the 24 golden answers (2026-11-25): every miss was read in context; only pure format variants of an already-keyed value were added. Misses left as genuine omissions: a2q1-itc-16-2-aa (all 3 golden answers cite Sec 16(2)(c), not 16(2)(aa)) and a2q4-rebate-2-75 (golden hybrid answer omits the 2.75% tier).
